line_items.reasoning: NVDA guided Q1 revenue to $43B +/- 2% (implying a range of ~$42.1B–$43.9B), and reported $44B, coming in above the top end of that range.

Underlying non-GAAP gross margin of 71.3% was only slightly above the 71% +/- 50bps guide; reported GAAP/non-GAAP margins were severely compressed to ~60.5%/61% due to the one-time $4.5B H20 charge, but the core operational margin essentially matched guidance.
Both Data Center (up 73% YoY, driven by Blackwell) and Gaming (record $3.8B, up 48% sequentially) grew strongly in Q1, exceeding the expectation of mere sequential growth in both segments.

No full-year Automotive or opex actuals were reported for Q1 in isolation; the Automotive ramp toward ~$5B FY2026 and mid-30s opex growth trajectory appear on track based on available commentary, with no explicit deviation noted.
Q1 GAAP opex and non-GAAP opex were not explicitly called out as deviating from the guided ~$5.2B GAAP / ~$3.6B non-GAAP figures, and no surprise was flagged in the reported results.
